title: Purchase Order Cart and Send PO
summary: One shared cart per vendor: check the lines, download the PO as Excel, PDF or CSV, or email it to the vendor with Send PO.

blocks.text: The cart has one panel per vendor. Everyone with cart access sees the same lines, on the website and in the app. Every vendor starts collapsed: its header shows the item and case counts, the estimated cost and any removal requests. Open a vendor to change it. Changes save by themselves.

items: **Qty** is cases. **Case of** is units in one case. Qty 2 with Case of 12 is 24 units.

Each line shows what is in stock and, a moment later, its projection, like "~14/week · suggested 10 · on hand 6". The suggestion uses the same window as New order (3 months of sales, order for 1 month unless changed), so an item shows the same number on both. **Use 10** sets the suggestion.
Lines are grouped by PO section, in the order they print on the PDF.
Cost, the estimate and the stock figures are only for you. They never appear on the PDF.

blocks.text: **Add items** at the top adds several items to one vendor in one go. Pick the vendor, search this vendor's products or all products, tick items into the **To add** list (each starts at its suggested quantity for the same Order for window as New order, 1 month unless changed), then **Add to <vendor>'s cart**. An item already in that vendor's cart can't be added again, so its quantity is never replaced. Not in inventory yet? **Add it as a new item**.
Only an admin can remove a line, set it to 0 or clear a vendor's cart. Anyone else selects **Request removal**. Admins get a notification and approve or reject.

**Download** makes the PO for one vendor. Pick **Excel**, **PDF** or **CSV** from its menu. The PDF has your store's letterhead, then a serial number, the vendor code, the item name and the quantity, grouped by PO section. Excel and CSV have the same columns in the same order. Lines at 0 are skipped. It is not a {pos} purchase order; nothing is sent to {pos}.

items: Select **Send PO** on a vendor. A preview shows who it goes to (the vendor's saved contacts, those marked Gets POs ticked), the subject, the message and the PDF.
Add a note or CC addresses for this send if you like. **Preview PDF** shows the attachment, and **Download** saves it as Excel, PDF or CSV.
Select **Send**. It goes from the store's email account.
Once it has gone out, the order is recorded as placed and those lines leave the cart.
If it doesn't go out, nothing changes: you see why, and **Try again** sends it. Pressing Send twice never emails twice.
Rarely it is unclear whether it went. Check the Sent folder, then choose **It went out** or **Send again**.
To addresses must be saved on [Vendor contacts](page:vendor_contacts). CC can be any email address.
Every send is listed under **Recent PO sends** on Vendor contacts.

blocks.text: Ordered another way? Select **Order placed** on the vendor once the order has really gone. That records it on Placed Orders and empties that vendor's cart.
The demo store can look around the cart but can't add, send or place anything.
